title: Impossible to add/remove liquidity if numTokens < MAX_NUM_TOKENS
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  ``` function addLiquidity(         uint256[MAX_NUM_TOKENS] calldata amounts_,         uint256 minLpAmount_,         address receiver_         )         external         nonReentrant         returns (uint256)     { ```  Here it required \_amount to be provided with the length of 32. On the other hand, later it requires a different thing:  ``` if (amounts_.length != _numTokens) revert Pool__InvalidParams(); ```  So, these two requirements conflict when we have \_numTokens below 32. Thus, it is impossible to provide liquidity
